subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'TEA' is written as '23' and 'SKY' is written as '52'. How will 'JAM' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :(3) is subtracted from the sum of the position values according to the English alphabetic series in the given word.

​So,

 
• 'TEA' is written as '23'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd3f1e26b83dc76e47cfc19ffff1b2e0232738f8f5fbf0b9d26c8625fed0178a.png] 

​And,

 
• 'SKY' is written as '52'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94c0ec3c5afcaec2d4843b99fefb7e66a287c95d657c06f7c4a76dbce5d26371.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'JAM' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e324de372c316293684057026a5f7348c0e32ed2903fc8fc0f1837fd1df40ef.png] 

Hence, "21" is the correct answer.

5b:T82
